## Summary

Zephyr Point Media Ltd: theft from a locked van of a 3D printer and filament stock at a shared workshop on Tanner Row. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 6,264 dollars.

## Facts

Zephyr Point Media Ltd reported the loss on 20 April 2026 under policy CC-1481 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss]. The items are a 3D printer and filament stock [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026, reference CR/2026/4169 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. Invoice 1 is for 5,181 dollars [invoice 1]. Invoice 2 is for 1,083 dollars [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply. The workshop is a shared space, but the items were in a locked container at the time, which is the exception in the clause [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply on the file as it stands. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 20 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss], [policy].

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply. The loss is a theft and no gradual deterioration is alleged [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,264 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (5,181 dollars and 1,083 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the schedule, so none applies [policy, clause 9.1].

---

Two points to confirm before payment:
- **Date of theft:** The file does not state when the theft took place. Exclusion 7.5 is measured from the loss, so the date should be confirmed to show the police report fell within seven days.
- **Custody:** The file does not say whose van it was or confirm the items were in the insured's custody. This should be confirmed for clause 4.2.
